keyPoints: Seedhe samanupat (direct proportion) me ek rashi badhne par doosri bhi badhti hai — zyada kilo cheeni, zyada daam.
x aur y seedhe samanupat me hon to x/y = k (sthirank) — x1/y1 = x2/y2 se agyat maan nikalo — jaise 2/6 = x/15 se x = 5.
Vileem samanupat (inverse proportion) me ek badhe to doosri ghate — zyada mazdoor, kam din me kaam poora.
x aur y vileem samanupat me hon to x x y = k (sthirank) — x1 x y1 = x2 x y2 — jaise 4 mazdoor 6 din me to 8 mazdoor 3 din me.
Samay-kaam ke sawalon me pehle ek vyakti/din ki kshamta nikaalo, phir maangi hui sankhya se guna-bhaag karo — kul kaam = kshamta x samay x vyakti.
Gati-samay-doori me gati sthir ho to doori samay ke seedhe samanupat me hoti hai.
Aam galti: har badhte-ghatte sambandh ko seedha maan lena — pehle jaancho ki guna sthir hai ya anupat sthir.
subject: Maths
title: Seedha aur Vileem Samanupat
